# Estimated block probabilities of a network histogram fit

Returns the estimated block probability matrix of a fitted network
histogram. Unlike
[`fitted()`](https://enigmasong.github.io/nethist/reference/fitted.nethist.md),
which expands the estimate to pairs of vertices,
[`coef()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html) returns one value per pair
of blocks.

## Usage

``` r
# S3 method for class 'nethist'
coef(object, type = "nethist", ...)

# S3 method for class 'multinethist'
coef(object, type = "nethist", ...)
```

## Arguments

- object:

  a fit returned by
  [`nethist`](https://enigmasong.github.io/nethist/reference/nethist.md),
  [`hnethist`](https://enigmasong.github.io/nethist/reference/hnethist.md),
  or
  [`multinethist`](https://enigmasong.github.io/nethist/reference/multinethist.md).

- type:

  one of `"nethist"` (default) or `"prob"`. `"nethist"` returns the
  network histogram, the block probabilities divided by the edge density
  `rho_hat`. `"prob"` returns the block probabilities.

- ...:

  currently unused.

## Value

For `nethist` and `hnethist` fits, a \\k \times k\\ matrix, where \\k\\
is the number of blocks. For `multinethist` fits, a \\k \times k \times
L\\ array, where \\L\\ is the number of layers.

## Details

For an `hnethist` fit, the probabilities are those of the selected
hybrid model, in which blocks of the same shape share one value.

## See also

[`fitted.nethist`](https://enigmasong.github.io/nethist/reference/fitted.nethist.md),
[network_histogram-accessors](https://enigmasong.github.io/nethist/reference/network_histogram-accessors.md)

## Examples

``` r
# \donttest{
set.seed(42)
data(polblog)
fit <- nethist(polblog)
coef(fit, type = "prob")
```
